say:0:1620986401:1.text: That familiar signature belongs to Zorya. She was the one who raised the tombstone, to honor a student she once had.
say:0:1620986401:1.source_cn: 熟悉的魔力痕迹来自佐尔娅，是她建立了墓碑，为了纪念她曾...
say:0:1620986401:1.male: That familiar signature belongs to Zorya. She was the one who raised the tombstone, to honor a student she once had.
say:0:1620986401:1.female: That familiar signature belongs to Zorya. She was the one who raised the tombstone, to honor a student she once had.

say:1:1620986402:1.text: Zorya was also the one who dug the coffin up, since, according to her, "it no longer serves that purpose."
say:1:1620986402:1.source_cn: 佐尔娅又称“棺材已经用不上了”。是她用魔法重新挖出了棺材。
